subject: Chinese jade archery thumb ring. A thick short hollow jade cylinder in three-quarter view, broad wall, clearly visible large finger hole, pale celadon carved stepped rim and muted moss green inner shadow. Not a thin wedding band.

Ancient Chinese jade belt hook, side three-quarter view. Substantial celadon S-curved carved hook with blunt dragon-head hooked tip, thick elongated belly, small fastening stud visible underneath, dark jade incised central groove. Clearly a wearable belt hook, not a snake.

Chinese scholar's portable scroll book box pendant. A small rectangular dark walnut wooden carrying case, visibly open upper lip showing two rolled ivory scroll ends, brass corner braces and simple carved panel, cord loop at top. A box holding scrolls, not a modern bag.

Chinese black jade seal pendant, three-quarter view. Square substantial ink-black stone seal base, tiny squat carved stepped handle on top, one restrained pale jade inset on front, short dark red hanging cord. Clearly carved stone stamp, not a green tower.

Ancient iron anchor pendant. Sturdy dark iron shank, large ring at top, transverse wooden stock, two outward angled broad triangular flukes at bottom, short rope wrapped around shank, bronze rivets. Recognizable anchor silhouette with large negative spaces, not a shield.

Chinese nautical compass pendant in three-quarter front view. Octagonal aged brass casing, ivory dial with simple black cardinal ticks and one red pointing needle, jade green outer rim, small rope loop at top. No writing, readable actual compass not an abstract circle.
